simple.meaning: צַלַּחַת (tsallachath) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something advanced or deep , i.e. a bowl ; figuratively, the bosom.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 21:13. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צַלַּחַת (H6747) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: צַלַּחַת (tsallachath) / H6747 is traced through 2 Kings 21:13, Proverbs 19:24, Proverbs 26:15 with generated occurrence evidence.
